0: scale minimum, prior mean, coding value
1: prior scale, coding value, lag order
2: prior shape Beta(2,2), number of factors, VARX order
5: prior scale N(0,5); STOP-BANG high-risk cut
7: diary nights at baseline; also maximum attained tree depth
8: STOP-BANG maximum; number of pain items; flip angle (deg)
10: NUTS maximum tree depth cap; also the top of the 0-10 rating scale
12: number of rows per subject in step00 (quarters 0-11)
50: STOP-BANG age cut-point (years); framewise-displacement sphere radius (mm)
80: left-knee stimulation count (demographics, not a pipeline output today)
94: right-knee stimulation count (demographics, not a pipeline output today)
-27: MNI coordinate (left anterior insula ROI centre)
100: upper bound of the 0-100 evoked-pain rating scale
229: analytic sample size (also a pipeline value; whitelisted so it never reads as unmatched)
500: Johnson-Neyman grid size; np.linspace(..., 500) at lib/coupling_model.py:1103
971: sample size of Edwards et al. (2008), a cited study
0.99: NUTS target acceptance (a setting; also appears in diagnostics)
1.01: conventional R-hat criterion (a threshold, not a result)
7000: quoted from the SUBMITTED manuscript's inaccurate convergence note; deliberately has no source
3.375: voxel volume, 1.5^3 mm^3 -- arithmetic stated in Methods, not a pipeline output
